title: Nircraft
description: Nircraft is an SMP with RPG elements and developed by its owner! Full leveling system, land claiming, bosses, events, duels, and so much more packed into one SMP!
body:
![Nircraft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f6537682b90e2c225e91bf48c1b98421b2b4e708.jpeg)
Nircraft is a fully custom server developed by its owner. The server welcomes PvPers, builders, friendly or aggressive. There's a cool little community that welcomes anyone new! The server offers a full leveling system, with challenges and a new custom resource that is required to use netherite, elytras, maces, and end crystals. We also have a mace limit of 3, to which all mace holders are announced to the server. We have death chests, hearts as you level up, fun night events that consist of boss fights and mutated monsters, and so much more! I've put a lot of time into making the plugin for this server so I hope you join and have fun!
